{{nihongo|'''Iwahashi Shrine'''|磐椅神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].

'''Iwahashi Shrine''' (いわはしじんじゃ) is a shrine in {{ill|Inawashiro|arz|ايناواشيرو|ceb|Inawashiro|de|Inawashiro (Fukushima)|es|Inawashiro (Fukushima)|fa|ایناواشیرو، فوکوشیما|fr|Inawashiro|hu|Inavasiro|id|Inawashiro, Fukushima|it|Inawashiro|ja|猪苗代町|ko|이나와시로정|mg|Inawashiro|ms|Inawashiro, Fukushima|my|အိဝနရှိရိုမြို့|no|Inawashiro|pl|Inawashiro|ru|Инавасиро|sv|Inawashiro|tl|Inawashiro, Fukushima|tr|Inawashiro|uk|Інавасіро (Фукусіма)|ur|انواشیرو|vi|Inawashiro, Fukushima|zh|豬苗代町|zh_yue|豬苗代町|qid=Q669633}}, {{ill|Fukushima Prefecture|Q71707|qid=Q71707}}. Its {{ill|Q712534|lt=former rank}} was prefectural shrine.

=== Overview ===
It is a high-ranking {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} and is said to have been the largest grand shrine in the district. The shrine name derives from the old name of {{ill|Mount Bandai|arz|جبل مونت بانداى|be|Бандай|ceb|Bandai San|cs|Bandai (sopka)|de|Bandai (Vulkangruppe)|el|Όρος Μπαντάι|es|Monte Bandai|et|Bandai|fa|کوه باندای|fr|Mont Bandai|it|Monte Bandai|ja|磐梯山|ka|ბანდაის მთა|ko|반다이산|lld|Mont Bandai|lt|Bandajus|ml|ബന്ദായ് പർവ്വതം|ms|Gunung Bandai|my|ဘန်းဒိုင်းတောင်|nl|Bandai (vulkaangroep)|pnb|ٹلہ بنڈائ|pt|Monte Bandai|ro|Muntele Bandai|ru|Бандай (вулкан)|sk|Bandai (sopka)|sv|Bandai (vulkan)|tr|Bandai Dağı|uk|Бандай (гора)|zh|磐梯山|qid=Q714605}}, "Iwahashiyama," and preserves the history of mountain worship of the sacred mountain itself. In the precincts stands Ōshika-zakura (one of the {{ill|Five Great Cherry Trees of Aizu|Q21652321|qid=Q21652321}}), said to have been transplanted from Kyoto when an imperial envoy visited during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Murakami|Q374015|qid=Q374015}}. {{ill|Hanitsu Shrine|Q11423723|qid=Q11423723}} is regarded as a subordinate shrine.

=== Enshrined deities ===
*{{ill|Ōyamatsumi|abstract|Q386563|az|Ooyamatsimu|de|Ōyamatsumi|fa|اویاماتسومی|fr|Ōyamatsumi|hr|O-Yama-Tsu-mi|ja|オオヤマツミ|ko|오야마쓰미노카미|mni|ꯑꯣꯌꯃꯠꯁꯨꯃꯤ|ru|Ооямацуми|simple|Ōyamatsumi|sv|Ōyamatsumi|tr|Ōyamatsumi|zh|大山津見|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamatsumi-no-Mikoto}}
*{{ill|Haniyasu-hiko and Haniyasu-hime|it|Haniyasu|ja|ハニヤス|pl|Haniyasu|zh|波邇夜須毘古神與波邇夜須毘賣神|qid=Q9285919|lt=Haniyama-hime-no-Mikoto}}

=== History ===
In the time of Emperor Ōjin, {{ill|Takenouchi no Sukune|Q1073668|qid=Q1073668}} enshrined the deities on the summit of Mount Iwahashi. Later, in the time of Emperor Shōmu, it moved to the present location.

On September 4, {{ill|1908|Q2056|qid=Q2056}} (Meiji 41), {{ill|Prince Arisugawa Takehito|Q875481|qid=Q875481}} and {{ill|Princess Mieko of Arisugawa|Q7004966|qid=Q7004966|lt=Princess Mieko}} visited and each planted a pine and a cherry tree<ref>Higuchi Mitsutaka, ''Koko Tanshō'' (Kōkan Gakuin, Meiji 43), p.10.</ref>.
